args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate.
- **Identified target**: The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0 (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — status `rolled_out`.
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, describing the health-check failure and the rollback. On-call has been paged.
